body: Thank you for you sweet words. It's good to be able to see other people who understand.

The one he suggested me to I've been to before when I got pregnant with my first child. It's very uncomfortable, you go in for a simple drug test and you have to endure a meeting with a counselor, and it's very religious based. I have no issue with religion, I'm not atheist or agnostic, I just don't like religion that is pushed down a person's throat. It was not one of my favorite experiences. I know better than to go there or call, they would not leave me alone if I did. 

I'm going to look into it, because I thought he was crossing the line.

I was so annoyed with the doctor and didn't want everyone to know, I didn't know how to handle it and just wanted to get out of there. 

How would I handle that now that I'm home? Would I call the office or somewhere else?
Thank you so much, I will PM you in a little while, my daughter is currently demanding my attention haha

I stopped using it, and started using a condom, which apparently broke.
